description: The null keyword for a list of the dynamic pseudo-type becomes a null of that type
notes: The dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, and in a type specification it stands for any type, so no value should have it as a list's element type. The spec's call rules also make the null keyword, a null of the dynamic pseudo-type, which doesn't match a list of the dynamic pseudo-type, an error. hashicorp/hcl converts arguments to their parameter's type with go-cty's convert.Convert (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), which converts a null to the specification as if it were a type (getConversion in cty/convert/conversion.go).
